clinical_intent: For a prostate HDR treatment using 18 catheters, each with 15 dwell positions spaced at 5 mm intervals, calculate the total number of potential source positions. If the treatment planning system optimizes dwell times for all positions, what is the total number of dwell time variables? If the source can be placed at any 1 mm increment instead of 5 mm, how does this affect the number of optimization variables?
